purpose: Initial Phase 0 contract fixtures for future automated tests

assistants.name: Support Assistant A
assistants.fallback_message: I cannot find that answer in the provided information.

assistants.name: Support Assistant B
assistants.fallback_message: I cannot find that answer in the provided information.

cases.expect: safe not-found or unauthorized result and no data disclosure

cases.given: an assistant already has five knowledge files
cases.expect: upload rejected and no new file association

cases.given: a PDF or DOCX larger than 10 MB
a malformed, encrypted, scanned, empty, or unsupported document
cases.expect: processing_state is failed and no chunks are retrievable

cases.given: an unpublished assistant with valid saved configuration
cases.when: the owner publishes without using the playground

cases.given: an active published snapshot and later draft changes
cases.when: a public visitor sends a message before publish/update
cases.expect: the response uses the previous active snapshot

cases.given: no retrieved chunk passes the configured similarity boundary
cases.expect: the configured fallback is returned and no business-specific answer is generated

cases.given: the widget has an opaque public assistant identifier
cases.when: it sends a public chat request
cases.expect: only the active published snapshot is used and draft/owner data is not returned
